It looks like you tried to run the **`/quota`** slash command from **Git Bash** on Windows, and MSYS2 path conversion rewrote `/quota` to `C:/Program Files/Git/quota` before passing it to `agy`.

- **Path check:** `C:/Program Files/Git/quota` does not exist on disk (`Test-Path` returned `False`).
- **Why I can't run it for you:** I don't have a tool to inspect your account quota or execute interactive CLI slash commands. As shown by `agy --help`, there is also no standalone `quota` or `usage` CLI subcommand.
- **How to check your quota:**
  1. Start an interactive session by running `agy` (in PowerShell, Command Prompt, or Git Bash).
  2. Type `/quota` (or `/usage`) directly inside the `agy` TUI prompt to open the **Models & Quota** panel.
  3. If you pass a literal `/...` argument to `agy` from Git Bash on the command line, prefix the command with `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` (or run from PowerShell) so Git Bash does not rewrite it into `C:/Program Files/Git/...`.

See [cli.md](file:///<home>/.gemini/antigravity-cli/builtin/skills/antigravity_guide/references/cli.md) and the CLI reference (`https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/reference`) for more details. If you meant something else by `C:/Program Files/Git/quota`, let me know!
